holdout.reason: No candidate passes all validation performance gates on both profiles; holdout outcomes remain unobserved.

decision: No configuration meets both-profile validation performance gates. Preserve personal LinUCB; do not observe holdout outcomes, promote the forced-sleep no-op controls, or retune these search/validation seeds.
limits: Search4seed proxy and validation8seed selection statistics are not unbiased final model-performance evidence. Holdout20seed outcomes were intentionally not observed.
Warm6 was known from hard midnight guards to affect forced sleep only; the pre-search amendment excluded inert configurations from selection while retaining all control results.
Choice-effect counts compare actions at the same candidate state, not long-horizon counterfactual trajectories.
Existing synthetic, role-independent reward, hourly ordinary plan, transient stress and own-state depth1 opportunity cost limitations remain.
This is a finite deterministic grid, not LLM fine-tuning, self-modifying source code or automatic runtime deployment. Runtime artifact/CAS/rollback still needs separate design/review.
Verification reruns repeat the same fixed configurations/seeds; they are not additional independent trials or candidates.
No private archive input, paid API, GPU or new automation was used. Native Sites tools remain unavailable.
